name: Blue Pearl Agriventures Limited
about: Blue Pearl Agriventures Limited engages in the processing, marketing, trading, import, export, selling, and dealing in various kinds of agro/agri/food products. It provides spices, oil seeds, grains, vegetables, herbs, pickles, and other items derived from agricultural, farming, or relevant activities. The company was formerly known as Blue Pearl Texspin Limited and changed its name to Blue Pearl Agriventures Limited in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
